title: A plain Space campaign or drip step went out with no postal address in its footer, so commercial mail from those paths did not meet CAN-SPAM

source.ref: Found by the LIVE-707 builder drafting the Space email acceptable-use policy (PR #3066); ADR-1663

detail:
FILED 2026-09-29 by the LIVE-707 builder (Space email AUP draft, PR #3066). CAN-SPAM asks every commercial email to carry a valid physical postal address. The block-built email shell (lib/email-studio/shell.ts) already printed "Frequency Labs Holdings, 802 Caminito Azul, Carlsbad, CA 92011" from a private constant. The plain-text renderers did not: the Space campaign composer (renderCampaignHtml in lib/spaces/campaigns.ts, also used by the event broadcast), its scheduled send twin (lib/spaces/campaigns-send-due.ts) and the Space drip (lib/spaces/drip-runner.ts) closed their footer at the Unsubscribe link. Re-tested on main at 60567b67e before building (ADR-1082): the same bare footer was in four more plain renderers, the lead nurture drip (lib/nurture/runner.ts), the platform campaign composer (campaignEmail in lib/studio/campaigns.ts), the member automations email (lib/automations.ts) and the Studio agent note (lib/studio/agent.ts).

CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1663). The postal line moved to one module, lib/email-studio/postal.ts (PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE plus postalFooterHtml()). The block shell reads it, and all seven plain renderers append it under their unsubscribe line; the platform campaign text part prints it too. A per-Space EmailBrand.address still overrides the block shell. No migration. Tests: lib/email-studio/postal.test.ts, plus a postal case in lib/spaces/campaigns.test.ts, campaigns-send-due.test.ts, drip-runner.test.ts and lib/studio/campaigns.test.ts. The same PR fixes lib/email.ts: its footers (the emailShell footer every transactional and member email renders, and the scan-intro, signup-recovery and event-claim text parts) read COMPANY_POSTAL_ADDRESS, which docs/LAUNCH.md said was never set, and fell back to the site host with no address. They now read envString("COMPANY_POSTAL_ADDRESS", PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE), so the env var wins when set and the platform line prints otherwise (test: lib/email.test.ts). docs/LAUNCH.md and docs/NETWORK-CRM.md now call the var an optional override.

verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1663). Reads lib/email-studio/postal.ts: it must export PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE and postalFooterHtml and carry a street address with a state and ZIP. Reads lib/email-studio/shell.ts: the footer prints escapeHtml(PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE) and keeps no POSTAL_ADDRESS of its own. Reads the seven plain renderers (Space campaigns, Space scheduled send, Space drip, lead nurture, platform campaigns, automations, Studio agent): each imports postalFooterHtml from the postal module and closes its footer with it after the Unsubscribe link; the platform campaign text part prints the line too. Reads lib/email.ts: it imports PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE, reads envString("COMPANY_POSTAL_ADDRESS", PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE), has no raw process.env.COMPANY_POSTAL_ADDRESS read and no Frequency™ · ${BASE_URL} fallback, and orgContactLine returns the escaped postal address. Then walks every non-test .ts/.tsx under lib/ for a footer that still ends at Unsubscribe with no address. Fails on main (no postal module; seven bare footers; lib/email.ts falls back to the site host). Each arm mutation-fired. Exits 79 only when a renderer file is gone.
